key_insight: MintAct shows that one unified vision-language agent can handle UI grounding, multi-step navigation, and visual tool use across mobile, desktop, and web—matching specialized systems. The key breakthrough is a scalable training and RL setup that lets a single model family generalize across digital environments.
problem_solved: AI agents are usually built for one domain at a time, such as mobile apps, desktop interfaces, or web tasks. This paper tackles the challenge of creating a single visual agent that can operate reliably across all these environments and tools.
method: Trains a family of vision-language models at 2B, 4B, and 8B parameter scales.
Uses carefully designed environments, datasets, and training recipes to unify grounding, navigation, and tool use.
Builds scalable environment and reinforcement learning infrastructure to support large-scale agent training across hundreds of hosted environments.
impact: For practitioners, MintAct suggests that a single general-purpose agent can replace multiple domain-specific systems, simplifying deployment and maintenance. It also provides a practical recipe for building more capable digital assistants that work across platforms.

paper_title: MintAct: A Unified Visual Agent for Digital Environments
paper_authors: Mingfei Gao, Rui Tian, Haiming Gang, Bohan Zhai, Le Zhang
